'''RX-4-9''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/ln starfighter]]<ref name="CSWE" /> which was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="DB" /> Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after<ref name="CSWE" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY's]] [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> RX-4-9 pursued the<ref name="CSWE" /> [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="Falcon CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|313-314|''Millennium Falcon''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
RX-4-9 was introduced in [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" />
